ios.desc:
Analytics for Cloudflare® brings powerful statistics & insights for your Cloudflare protected websites to your iPhone & iPad.
Beautiful graphs, simple metrics & widgets provide you with essential information to keep track of your site's performance.

→ Keep track of the following key metrics over a period of the last month (30D), the last week (7D) or the last 24 hours (24H)

— VISITORS —
• Total unique visitors to your server or website
• Unique visitors visualized over the selected time period
• Total page views

— REQUESTS —
• Total requests to your server or website
• Requests visualized over the selected time period
• % of cached requests
• % of encrypted requests

— SAVED BANDWIDTH —
• Total bandwidth served through Cloudflare
• Bandwidth visualized over the selected time period
• % of cached bandwidth
• % of encrypted bandwidth

— THREATS —
• Total number of threats detected by Cloudflare
• Threats over the selected time period



—

If you enjoy Analytics for Cloudflare, please leave a review on the App Store.
For any questions or feedback, please feel free to contact me via support@visits.cloud.

—

Analytics for Cloudflare® is powered by the official Cloudflare API.
The developer of Analytics for Cloudflare® is not directly affiliated with Cloudflare.
